messages:
alex: Anyone bumped into noise in apples-to-apples lately? ran synthetic vs replay sweep, weird perf delta with KV warmup
priya: yep. saw 8-12% P95 regression on A100 when switching kernel sel to 'auto'.
jamie: can you paste repro? Also which batching heuristics? continuous vs fixed?
alex: minimal repro: `run-load --profile --replay /replays/checkout-2026 --kernels auto,fast_gemm --batching continuous --kv-warmup=off`
Output: p95 went from 62ms -> 71ms
(Command and flame attached)
maya: interesting. our profiling shows kernel selection choosing small-matmul path increasing context-switches. attaching perf snippet:
```
cpu cycles: 1.2B
l1 miss: 12M
cuda kernels: matmul_small (73%), matmul_large (20%)
```
Maybe heuristics favor smaller matmuls to save compute but overhead hurts throughput.
rafael: what about KV cache behavior? Did you enable serialized KV loads? we saw hits rate drop with replay because prefix alignment differs.
alex: right — replay sequences had variable prefixes; kv warmup off meant misses. With `kv_warmup=on` p95 returned to 64ms. But quant profiles also shift kernel selection.
priya: we ran quant sweep (int8 dynamic vs q4f) — q4f kept quality but made decoding CPU-bound in some microbatches, speculative decoding increased tail when spec threshold low.
jamie: did you gate regressions? We have a regression gate that runs 5k replays + synthetic 10k, compares LM quality by ppl and token-f1. Any big diffs?
alex: Gate flagged model-v2-quant-int8 on perf but quality diff <0.5% ppl. Debate: accept perf regressions under 10% if cost saving >30%?
maya: ops perspective: we need deterministic apples-to-apples: same seed, same replay trace, same batch size distribution. Our synthetic generator wasn't matching real arrival skew. I pushed updates to traffic-emulator.
replay-bot: started replay job 1780000100 on cluster-prod (nodepool=dedicated-p3). logs: s3://replays/checkout-2026/logs/1780000100
alex: I propose new benchmark methodology doc: 1) baseline with replay harness (real traces), 2) controlled synthetic with tunable skew, 3) kernel-only microbench for kernel selector, 4) kv-warmup sensitivity table, 5) quant+speculative matrix. Include cost-per-token calc.
rafael: :thumbsup: fine. Also add per-token latency breakdown from trace, e.g., kv-load, matmul, dispatch, copy.
priya: I'll run full matrix overnight — will push results and perf flamegraphs. Leaving canary set to 20% for canary rollouts.
jamie: cool. add ticket to run regression gate after quant changes: INF-3421
maya: also add note: synthetic loads should include jitter and burstiness. I added `--burst=poisson:lambda=3` to emulator.
alex: thanks all. I'll draft doc and link in #eng-runtime tomorrow. short action items: @priya run matrix, @maya update emulator, @rafael add per-token probes, @jamie create INF-3421. end.
